from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
